items.title: Higgsfield Debuts 'Kök Börü' Showcasing Hybrid Human-AI Animation Pipeline
items.excerpt: Premiering at SIGGRAPH 2026, the 15-minute animated short — a historical drama rooted in Central Asian folklore — was made by a team of 12 in two weeks on the Higgsfield platform. The studio walked through a hybrid, human-conditioned pipeline built on hand-drawn character designs, props and painted textures.

items.title: Autodesk Adds Maya, 3ds Max, Flow Production Tracking and Arnold Tools
items.excerpt: Autodesk's SIGGRAPH 2026 announcements include MotionMaker 'Bring Your Own Data' in Maya, letting animators condition AI-assisted motion on their own performance data, plus editable 3D Gaussian Splats in 3ds Max, Review in Flow Production Tracking and real-time Arnold viewport rendering.

items.title: Lightcraft Technology Opens Spark Story Beta at SIGGRAPH 2026
items.excerpt: Lightcraft launched a rolling beta of Spark Story, its interactive previs tool, adding a 3D asset library, real-time compositing, Spark Atlas and direct USD loading — pushing generative previsualization closer to a working shot-planning pipeline.

items.title: SIGGRAPH: 'Kök Börü' Director Amina Ömirjan Talks Frankly About the Making of Higgsfield AI's New Short
items.excerpt: Co-director Amina Ömirjan discusses the craft realities of making Higgsfield AI's animated short 'Kök Börü' — where human artists led design and where generative tooling took over — and answers hard questions about AI animation.

items.title: SIGGRAPH: Autodesk Announces New Tools to Accelerate Animation & VFX Workflows
items.excerpt: Animation Magazine's SIGGRAPH 2026 write-up of Autodesk's AI-assisted animation and VFX updates across Maya, 3ds Max, Flow Production Tracking and Arnold, aimed at the time-sinks in blocking, environment rebuild and review.

items.title: Vigloo Studio: New AI Platform for Short-Form Microdramas
items.excerpt: Korean microdrama platform Vigloo launched the beta of Vigloo Studio, an AI-native production tool for serialized short-form storytelling. It consolidates AI video and image generation, character management and community features into one environment, replacing workflows that previously spanned up to 15 external tools.

items.title: Jamie Hearing on how Clear Angle is scanning the future of VFX
items.excerpt: From LiDAR to Gaussian splats, Clear Angle is capturing the real world so VFX teams can rebuild it — one scan, one face and one lava field at a time. A look at how neural capture is reshaping on-set data acquisition.

items.title: Adobe Premiere is adding a Generative Media Tool
items.excerpt: Adobe's new Generative Media Tool lets editors create AI-generated video and sound effects directly on the Premiere timeline — drag across empty track space, prompt, and choose a model — without leaving the NLE.

items.title: Netflix Used GenAI Workflows On Nearly 300 Titles This Year So Far
items.excerpt: Netflix says generative-AI workflows touched roughly 300 titles in the first half of 2026, concentrated in post-production — crowd extension, establishing shots and historical sequences.

items.title: Christopher Nolan Praises Gen Z For "Utterly Rejecting" AI Slop
items.excerpt: As Christopher Nolan prepares to take viewers on an IMAX odyssey, he argues the next generation of filmmakers is rejecting generative output on craft grounds — 'it's hitting at exactly the wrong time.'

items.title: SAG-AFTRA Recommends Members Opt-Out Of Meta's AI Feature
items.excerpt: As Meta's new AI image feature sparks likeness concerns, SAG-AFTRA is telling performers how to opt out and protect their image — a practical marker for how synthetic-performer consent is being handled.

items.title: Tubi's 'Substitute Teacher' & 'House Rules' Partner With AI Platform
items.excerpt: Tubi series 'Substitute Teacher' and 'House Rules', produced by Wall of Entertainment, have partnered with AI platform Chronicle Media — a streaming-scale test of AI tooling inside episodic production.

items.title: Raindance Film Festival, AI Platform IMGN Launch New Film Fund and Development Hub for Indie Filmmakers
items.excerpt: Raindance and AI platform IMGN are launching a development hub that puts generative production tooling — plus financing — in the hands of independent filmmakers.

items.title: Creatives from 'Sharknado' and 'Doctor Who' Are Now Making AI Films
items.excerpt: For its new slate, the startup Promise AI is pairing traditional screenwriters and showrunners with generative creators — including releasing the animated AI film 'Tuning In' — as a test of what a hybrid AI film crew looks like.

items.title: FREE SAM2 Matting Tool
items.excerpt: A free SAM2-based matting tool demoed for AI filmmakers — segmentation-driven roto/matte extraction that slots into a generative-video post workflow.
